heading: Fines
lead: The Postal Service may impose or remit fines on carriers transporting mail by air on routes extending beyond the borders of the United States for—

tree.text: unreasonable or unnecessary delay to mail; and
other delinquencies in the transportation of the mail.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective July 1, 1971, pursuant to Resolution No. 71–9 of the Board of Governors. See section 15(a) of Pub. L. 91–375, set out as a note preceding section 101 of this title.
